summary: GeoVax Labs filed an 8-K reporting entry into warrant exercise inducement letters with holders of existing warrants. The holders agreed to exercise 501,144 warrants for cash (~$595K gross proceeds) in exchange for new warrants to purchase up to 1,002,288 shares at $1.65/share. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners served as financial advisor. The filing describes a routine capital-raising transaction involving warrant inducement and issuance of new warrants, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The event is an ordinary equity-linked financing.
